title: Austin's Growth: Development, Utilities, Annexation
summary:
*   Reviewed updates on streamlining the city's development approval process.
*   Discussed simplifying policies for extending city utility services.
*   Advanced planning and discussion regarding the city's future annexation strategy.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the
presence of all Councilmerabers.
The City Manager Report on Legislative Update was presented.
Worksession items discussed were Update of Development Process Streamlining;
Simplification of Utility Extension Policies, as well as Annexation Plan and Discussion of
Future Worksessions.
